candidates.title: [Android/aarch64] Backend score prefers the SVE2 variant, which is 2x slower than the non-SVE variant on 128-bit VL mobile cores
candidates.snippet: ### Summary  `ggml_backend_load_best()` selects the CPU backend variant with the **highest `ggml_backend_score()`**, and the aarch64 score function awards points purely for the *presence of CPU features* (bit flags) — not for actual throughput. On Android builds this makes the SVE2 variant win on every ARMv9 mobile SoC, yet on 128-bit VL mobile cores it is ~**2× slower** than the non-SVE i8mm variant for prompt processing (prefill).
